claim: Netflix posted a 16% year-over-year decline in revenue during the fiscal second quarter of 2025.
summary: From prior knowledge Netflix fiscal Q2 2025 revenue increased about 16% year-over-year, not declined, so the claimed 16% year-over-year decline is contradicted.

sub_claims.note: From prior knowledge Netflix Q2 2025 revenue grew ~16% YoY to ~$11.08B, so direction was an increase not a decline; no citations per instructions.

sub_claims.text: The year-over-year revenue change was a 16% decline in fiscal Q2 2025.
sub_claims.stated_text: 16% year-over-year decline in revenue during the fiscal second quarter of 2025
